functions.name: UKCOMPANY
functions.description: Companies House record for one company: name, status, type, incorporation date, SIC codes, registered office, charges and filings count (gankdat uk-company-profiles).

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: Company number (e.g. 00000006) or a company name (the register's top search hit).

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: Optional: one field to return as a single value (company, status, company_type, incorporated_on, sic_codes, postal_code, locality, charges_outstanding ...). Leave out for the whole record as two rows.

functions.name: UKCHARITY
functions.description: Charity Commission register rows matching a charity name or number (gankdat uk-charities).

parameters.name: charity
parameters.description: Charity name (substring) or registered charity number.

parameters.name: rows
parameters.description: Optional: how many matching rows to return (1-100, default 10).

functions.name: CQC
functions.description: CQC regulated care locations matching a location name, provider or postcode (gankdat uk-care-locations).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Location or provider name (substring), or a postcode / outward code (e.g. SW1A).

parameters.name: rows
parameters.description: Optional: how many matching rows to return (1-100, default 10).

functions.name: SANCTIONS
functions.description: UK sanctions list designations whose name matches (gankdat uk-sanctions). Returns a header row and 'no match' when empty.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name to screen (case-insensitive substring of the designated name).

parameters.name: rows
parameters.description: Optional: how many matching rows to return (1-100, default 10).

functions.name: TENDERS
functions.description: UK public procurement notices from Find a Tender matching a search (gankdat uk-tenders), newest first.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Words to search across the notice (title, buyer, description).

parameters.name: rows
parameters.description: Optional: how many notices to return (1-100, default 10).

functions.name: QUERY
functions.description: Any gankdat register with one filter: =GANKDAT.QUERY("uk-schools", "postcode", "SW1"). Filters are the dataset's query parameters listed at gankdat.com/docs; "q" searches every text field.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Dataset slug, e.g. uk-schools, nhs-ods, uk-food-hygiene, uk-sponsors, eu-ted, sam-exclusions.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Query parameter name, e.g. q, name, postcode, status.

parameters.name: rows
parameters.description: Optional: how many rows to return (1-100, default 10).
